items.name: IsMetaclass
items.summary: Whether or not a class is a metaclass. Constructed by [`is_metaclass`].

items.name: any_base_class
items.signature: fn any_base_class<F>(class_def: &ast::StmtClassDef, semantic: &SemanticModel<'_>, func: F) -> bool where F: FnMut(&ruff_python_ast::Expr) -> bool
items.summary: Return `true` if any base class matches an [`Expr`] predicate.

items.name: any_member_declaration
items.signature: fn any_member_declaration<F>(class: &ast::StmtClassDef, func: F) -> bool where F: FnMut(ClassMemberDeclaration<'_>) -> bool

items.name: any_qualified_base_class
items.signature: fn any_qualified_base_class<F>(class_def: &ast::StmtClassDef, semantic: &SemanticModel<'_>, func: F) -> bool where F: Fn(ruff_python_ast::name::QualifiedName<'_>) -> bool
items.summary: Return `true` if any base class matches a [`QualifiedName`] predicate.

items.name: any_super_class
items.signature: fn any_super_class<F>(class_def: &ast::StmtClassDef, semantic: &SemanticModel<'_>, func: F) -> bool where F: Fn(&ast::StmtClassDef) -> bool
items.summary: Return `true` if any base class, including the given class, matches an [`ast::StmtClassDef`] predicate.

items.name: is_enumeration
items.summary: Return `true` if `class_def` is a class that has one or more enum classes in its mro

items.name: is_metaclass
items.summary: Returns `IsMetaclass::Yes` if the given class is definitely a metaclass, `IsMetaclass::No` if it's definitely *not* a metaclass, and `IsMetaclass::Maybe` otherwise.

items.name: iter_super_class
items.signature: fn iter_super_class<'stmt>(class_def: &'stmt ast::StmtClassDef, semantic: &'stmt SemanticModel<'_>) -> impl Iterator<Item = &'stmt ast::StmtClassDef>
items.summary: Returns an iterator over all base classes, beginning with the given class.

items.name: might_be_generic
items.summary: Returns true if a class might be generic.
